data.name: Laurențiu
data.long_meaning: Laurențiu is derived from the Latin word 'laurens', which means 'crowned' or 'wearing a laurel wreath'. In Christian tradition, it is believed that this name was given to Saint Laurențiu in honor of his victory over the pagan gods and his subsequent reward of a laurel wreath. The name therefore symbolizes triumph and victory.
